Example Paper
A. Author and B. Writer
January 2000
=== page 2 ===
INTRODUCTION
Momentum is a made-up subject for this made-up paper.
=== page 3 ===
DATA
We use all common stocks listed on the
Example Exchange.  Returns are ta-
  ken from the Example Price Database.
Our sample begins in January 1960. It covers every listed firm
and ends in December 1990.
=== page 4 ===
METHOD
Stocks are ranked on their cumulative return over the forma-
tion period. We consider formation periods of 6 and 12 months.
We skip one month between the formation period and the holding period.
=== page 5 ===
Each portfolio is equally weighted.
=== page 6 ===
We compare each strategy with the equal-
weighted market portfolio.
=== page 7 ===
Table 1
Top-decile portfolio, 12-month formation: 1.10 percent per month.
The equal-weighted market portfolio earns 0.90 percent per month.
